test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: E, F, G, H, I and J are sitting around a round table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). F is sitting to the immediate left of G and immediate right of E. J is sitting to the immediate right of H and immediate left of I. H is sitting to the immediate right of G. Who is sitting to the immediate left of E?
solution:
**Given: **E, F, G, H, I and J are sitting around a round table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

F is sitting to the immediate left of G and immediate right of E. H is sitting to the immediate right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0ef7c3255619f5bab662a7d905e5a02698ec8ba0f4414d2474fecf83ea7b943.png] 

J is sitting to the immediate right of H and immediate left of I. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8780a6fdbcae3312ae5dc651d93c44170e03b3772e95c072c0b046c902b7e92.png] 

Thus, I is sitting to the immediate left of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
